objective: Fix the live Hermes Discord/model-selection path so Discord uses the E3 Stage 2 worker pool and automatic router instead of silently sticking to the native current DeepSeek provider. Reconcile the now-passing provider workers, make routing auditable and non-sticky, deploy locally, and verify the full local routing path without weakening any gate.
allowed_scope: Consume owner authorization recorded at tasks-or-issues/2026-09-25-discord-e3-selector-authorization.md. Do not exceed that scope.

Inspect the actual installed Hermes Discord gateway/config/plugin surface under the owner's local Hermes installation and the repo-managed Chief integration. Determine exactly why the Discord /model provider picker shows native Hermes providers and why ordinary Discord messages remain on DeepSeek.

Prefer a supported extension/plugin/config integration. If a local installed Hermes file must be changed, create an exact reversible backup first and record its path/hash. Do not edit secrets or auth material.

Create a single operator-facing E3 worker/model surface in Discord. It must show the E3 worker identity, actual API model, readiness/qualification state, and unavailable reason for blocked workers. Do not present native Hermes provider selection as the automatic E3 router. If the native /model UI cannot be safely extended, add an explicit E3 model/route command and clearly label the native selector as transport/manual fallback rather than pretending it controls E3.

Wire normal Chief/Discord task execution to E3 Stage 2 automatic orchestration by default. Preserve an explicit manual worker override and a safe fallback for requests E3 cannot route. Never silently bypass Stage 2.

Fix E3 routing so it does not choose the first candidate merely because SQL/insertion order makes that candidate first. Hard-gate on Stage 2 allowed_workers, WorkerRegistry routable state and real adapter binding. Rank deterministically using qualification/evidence, task-family/role fit, capability hints, recorded historical performance and observed E2 provider health/capacity. Unknown cost/latency/capacity remains UNKNOWN and must not be guessed. Add a stable final tie-break only after evidence/task-fit scores.
Pass WorkerRegistry and any available E2 state into E3Router so provider/model identity is not 'unknown' when the roster knows it. Persist/print the actual selection rationale and scores for audit.

Reconcile current live execution evidence. Mistral Small (mistral-small-latest), LongCat 2.0 (LongCat-2.0), MiniMax M3 (MiniMax-M3) and Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 (hy3) have successful HTTP 200 smoke evidence on 2026-09-25 and may be marked execution-ready/routable only if the committed evidence is independently verified. Do not mark them QUALIFIED solely from smoke tests.

Add real ExecutionAdapterRegistry bindings for each independently verified newly-routable generic OpenAI-compatible worker using generic_openai_adapter. Keep GLM-5.3 Flash, Qwen3.7 Plus and Step 3.7 Flash non-routable because their current provider blockers remain unresolved.
Update the local Stage 2 state allowlist to the seven owner-authorized workers only after registry/binding tests and regression pass. No VPS deployment.

Add regression tests proving: blocked workers cannot be selected; allowed-but-unqualified workers are only eligible under the existing low-risk exploration/qualification rules; code/repository tasks do not deterministically stick to DeepSeek when Codex has better task-fit/evidence; image tasks route to the Google image worker; a manual override is honored only when the selected worker is allowed+routable; deterministic tie-break is stable; provider/model identity in router decisions is real roster data rather than unknown.

Run the full relevant regression and a bounded local production-routing acceptance. Use the smallest safe number of real provider calls; no retries unless an existing bounded policy explicitly allows one. Record E2 linkage and selection rationale. Do not send a synthetic Discord message externally on the owner's behalf; instead prove the gateway handler/integration locally and leave exactly one simple owner Discord acceptance message if an external inbound event is still required.
Update canonical status only from measured evidence. Do not claim Discord end-to-end live PASS unless an actual Discord inbound event was observed after deployment.
Never read, print, log, commit, or expose credential values. Do not modify auth.json or provider secrets.
stop_conditions: Stop and block if the installed Discord gateway has no safe/reversible integration point and modifying vendor code would require an unsupported destructive patch.
Stop and record the exact failure if any supposedly passing provider no longer passes the evidence/binding preconditions; do not reclassify it as routable without proof.
Do not enable GLM, Qwen or StepFun.
Do not weaken E1/E2/E3 verification or qualification gates.
Do not perform VPS cutover, reboot, sign-out, firewall changes, external account mutations, or secret migration.
notes: Observed defect before task: Discord screenshot shows native provider picker with DeepSeek current and no LongCat. Repo inspection shows E3Router constructed without WorkerRegistry/E2 state, _get_provider/_get_model return unknown, candidate ordering is qualification-confidence only, TeamAssembler takes first candidate, ADAPTER_MODULES only binds codex-cli/deepseek/google, while 2026-09-25 evidence records HTTP 200 for Mistral/LongCat/MiniMax/Tencent. Stage 2 state currently allows only codex-cli/deepseek/google.
